label: Jarlsberg
note: Developed 1956 by Ole Martin Ystgaard at the Dairy Institute of the Agricultural University of Norway from 1850s recipes and Swiss methods; Jarlsberg is a brand owned by Tine

about.text: Jarlsberg is a mild Swiss-type cow cheese from Norway with medium to large eyes, aged at least three months.

steps.note: Its formula is a trade secret and the starter cultures are Tine's; carbon dioxide from the bacterium forms the characteristic eyes.
